_comment: Photoshoot shoot file - a whole shoot in one file: the person, her outfits,
the lighting and style, the series plan, the scene and the prompt template.
JSON has no comments, so every explanation sits in a key starting with an
underscore (_comment). Photoshoot skips those keys, so this file loads as it is.
Open the Series node's shoot row (Shoot: ... File) and choose this file, or
copy it into ComfyUI/user/krea2_shoots/ - then it shows up there as a chip.
A preview shows what goes where before anything changes; Undo takes it back.
Every section is optional; a missing one leaves that node as it is. Each
section is the node's state as the node keeps it. Labels may be the English
names the interface shows (as here) or the German keys a saved shoot
carries - both load. A label that does not exist is reported and left out.
The Director (Series panel -> Director) writes the same format from one
name: Sunlit loft
brief: a red-haired woman in a sunlit loft, two outfits, calm and friendly
_comment_wardrobe: One tab per outfit. The series changes costume in blocks (or mixed, see outfitFolge).
_comment_series: anzahl = photos, start = first photo number, serienSeed = the seed when the
noise switch (aktiv.rausch) is off. pools narrow a field to a family
(haltung = posture, stimmung = mood) or switch it off. kameras and fokusse
are the framings and focus areas to use; null means all of them.
scene: a sunlit loft with tall windows, wooden floor, plants in the corner
